scope: Independent static review of the DSH task-delegation consumers, memory provenance, native worker boundary, owner surfaces, and UI. This file is not a full test-suite, SDK-run, GUI, real-model, or real-account attestation.

findings.trustedWorkerIdentity: Host task registration determines worker role; model-supplied kind, actor, task identity, or user envelope does not establish a human dialogue source.
findings.workerIsolation: Trusted worker sessions are excluded from persona attachment, intake, replay, and trace ingestion. They use an explicit independent worker preset.
findings.taskProcessIsolation: The same trusted task-tool projection applies to live, replay, and cold trace reads. Task calls and results retain safe navigation metadata without automatically importing full task process text into personality review.
findings.retainedMaterial: The personality can select real bounded archive material for the existing autonomous review process. It is recorded as agent material with actual archive origin and dependencies, without directly writing a personality decision.
findings.originalDialogue: Ordinary parent reasoning, visible assistant replies, and real human dialogue keep their original meaning and provenance.
findings.revocation: Explicit source revocation invalidates dependent task archives and in-flight task result caches; unavailable or revoked material is not silently recreated from old results.
findings.firstStep: The first provider assembly awaits actual preset attachment, contributes each persona section once, and refreshes actual wire schemas. The pre-step consumer restores the actual host turn and real admitted-message dependencies before task calls.
findings.resourcePresentation: Task-card summary previews, default status cards, pagination, and byte or character limits bound presentation and storage. Complete available documents remain separately archived; these limits do not decide what the personality must value or remember.
findings.autonomy: This change adds task interfaces and technical isolation. The reviewed code adds no task-topic whitelist, mandatory delegation, memory-value threshold, required growth, forced sleep, or prescribed decision frequency.
findings.hostPermissions: The worker inherits the existing DSH permission policy. An already full-access process does not become a new operating-system sandbox.

notes.detail: Parent GUI download remains bounded to 64MiB per file; archive capacity can be configured above this, so docs must distinguish them.
Worker inherits DSH permissions; code/shell in an already full-access policy is not a new OS sandbox.
